% ADDED figure (2026-11-23): exactly backward Compton scattering in the centre-of-mass frame with the spins along the axis (after PS Fig. 5.6 and PHY 513 Lecture 22 slide 29); generated by qft-C/tools/l22/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small, >=Stealth]
  \tikzset{spin/.style={->, line width=2.2pt, figR, >={Stealth[length=5pt,width=6pt]}}, mom/.style={->, line width=0.9pt}}
  % ----- before
  \node[font=\footnotesize, anchor=west] at (-5.6,1.15) {\textbf{before}};
  \draw[pline] (-4.6,0)--(-1.75,0); \draw[mom] (-1.8,0)--(-1.4,0);
  \node[above] at (-3.2,0.45) {$\gamma$, helicity $+1$ (R)};
  \draw[spin] (-3.6,0.28)--(-2.7,0.28); \node[figR, below] at (-3.15,-0.12) {$s_z = +1$};
  \draw[mom] (4.6,0)--(1.4,0);
  \node[above] at (3.2,0.45) {$e^-$, helicity $+\frac12$ (R)};
  \draw[spin] (3.5,0.28)--(2.75,0.28); \node[figR, below] at (3.1,-0.12) {$s_z = -\frac12$};
  \node[anchor=west, font=\footnotesize] at (5.3,0) {$J_z = +1 - \frac12 = +\frac12$};
  % ----- after
  \begin{scope}[yshift=-2.6cm]
  \node[font=\footnotesize, anchor=west] at (-5.6,1.15) {\textbf{after}, $\theta = \pi$};
  \draw[pline] (-1.75,0)--(-4.2,0); \draw[mom] (-4.15,0)--(-4.6,0);
  \node[above] at (-3.2,0.45) {$\gamma$, helicity $+1$ (R)};
  \draw[spin] (-2.75,0.28)--(-3.6,0.28); \node[figR, below] at (-3.15,-0.12) {$s_z = -1$};
  \draw[mom] (1.4,0)--(4.6,0);
  \node[above] at (3.2,0.45) {$e^-$, helicity $+\frac12$ (R)};
  \draw[spin] (2.75,0.28)--(3.5,0.28); \node[figR, below] at (3.1,-0.12) {$s_z = +\frac12$};
  \node[anchor=west, font=\footnotesize] at (5.3,0) {$J_z = -1 + \frac12 = -\frac12$};
  \end{scope}
  \draw[gray, ->] (-0.6,-4.0)--(0.6,-4.0) node[right, font=\scriptsize] {$\hat{\mathbf z}$};
  \node[font=\footnotesize, align=center] at (0,-4.75) {in general: $J_z^{\rm before} = h - \frac12$,\quad $J_z^{\rm after} = \frac12 - h'$;\quad equal only if $h + h' = 1$, impossible for $h, h' = \pm1$};
\end{tikzpicture}
